svg.text: Just left of the centre line
the 5×5 moved one column: ten cells changed hands
a boundary on every level at once
one axis: box = data square + one coarsest cell
tick 1: origin slid back 0.15 of a cell
tick 2: origin slid back 0.4 of a cell
tick 3: origin slid back 0.8 of a cell
its centre line, a fixed grid’s boundary
On a fixed grid every coarsest-level boundary is a boundary on every level, so the jumps add up, most at the centre lines: a cross.
Shifted by a uniform random part of one coarsest cell each tick, every boundary lands somewhere new, and the jumps average into a continuous force.
